column2: One suffering from abdominal tumor should drink buttermilk mixed with juices of sauvarchala, agni, hing and dipyaka; or with vida and dipyaka.
A decoction of amalaka, patola and mudga with ghee destroys erysipelas; another decoction of ginger, daru and navakshira with urine;
an alkali of the three pungents; a decoction of phala destroys swelling; jaggery, shigru, trivrit and rock salt powder.
A decoction of trivrit and phalaka with jaggery is a purgative; milk arisen from vacha-fruit decoction would be an emetic.
A hundred palas of triphala, separately steeped in bhringaraja; vidanga and iron powder, joined with ten parts;
shatavari, guduchi and agni, a hundred and twenty palas; one should lick it with honey, ghee and sesame oil, free of wrinkles and grey hair;
he would live a hundred years free of all disease. Triphala destroys all diseases, with honey, joined with sugar;
joined with sugar, honey and ghee, triphala with krishna; pathya, chitraka and ginger, guduchi and musali powder,
eaten with jaggery destroys disease and gives three hundred years. A little powder, hibiscus flower made into a lump, one releases in water;
the oil becomes ghee-like; a little powder with water; for fumigation a variety is seen with the afterbirth of a bull-biter;
again by fumigation with honey it appears as before. Camphor, water, frog-oil joined with patali root,
ground and smeared on both feet, a man may walk on embers. Having arranged grass-raising and the like, showing wonder,
destroying poison, seizure and disease, minor sport and love — that sixfold work is told, resting on the two perfections.
Mantra, meditation, medicine, narration, mudra and worship where there are fists — the fruit of the four aims is declared; one who recites it goes to heaven.
The Gayatri is the supreme mantra; having recited it one shares enjoyment and liberation. "Om namo Narayanaya" is the mantra accomplishing all aims;
Om namo bhagavate Vasudevaya gives all; "Om hum namo Vishnave" — this mantra is the supreme medicine.
By this the gods and demons became prosperous and free of disease. Helpfulness to beings and likewise dharma is the great medicine;
dharma, the maker of good dharma, the righteous — by these dharmas one is stainless: Shridada, Shrisha, Shrinivasa, Shridhara, Shrinikethana,
Shripati, Shriparama — by these one obtains prosperity. Kami, Kamaprada, Kama, Kamapala and Hari,
Ananda and Madhava — these names of Hari are for desire. Rama, Parashurama, Narasimha and Vishnu himself,
Trivikrama — these names should be recited by those who wish victory. For those who always study knowledge, Purushottama should be recited;
Damodara, remover of bonds; Pushkaraksha, destroyer of eye diseases; Hrishikesha, remover of fear — one should recite in medicine work.
Achyuta and the immortal mantra; Aparajita in battle; Narasimha when crossing water; in the east and so on, one wishing welfare;
one should remember Chakrin, Gadin, Sharngin and Khadgin; Narayana at all times; Narasimha destroys all fear;
Garudadhvaja, remover of poison; one should always recite Vasudeva. When storing grain and the like, in dreams, one should utter Ananta and Achyuta;

Narayana in bad dreams; the Water-Sleeper in burning and the like; Hayagriva for a student; the Creator of the world for obtaining a son; Balabhadra in matters of valor — a single name accomplishes the purpose.
One should wash a wound for pacification of a venereal sore, with powder of patola leaf, or pomegranate bark;
one should dust it with elephant dung and triphala powder. With triphala, rajas, yashti, markava, utpala and pepper,
with rock salt, one should cook oil; by anointing it removes vomiting. Markava juice with milk, two prasthas, with licorice and utpala,
one should cook a kudava of oil; that nasal medicine removes grey hair. Neem, patola, triphala, guduchi, khadira, vasaka,
bhunimba, patha, triphala, guduchi and red sandal — these two combinations destroy fever, leprosy, boils and the like.
A decoction of patola, guduchi, bhunimba, vasa, arishta, parpataka with khadira pacifies pustular fever.
Dashamula, guduchi, pathya, daru, punarnava; in fever, abscess and swelling shigru and vishva are beneficial.
Madhuka and neem leaves as a paste cleanse a wound; triphala, khadira, daruharidra, nyagrodha, atibala and kusha;
decoctions of neem, radish leaves are beneficial in cleansing; juice of karanja, arishta and nirgundi kills worms in wounds.
With dhataki, sandal, bala, samanga, madhuka and utpala, joined with daru and meda, a paste with ghee heals wounds.
Guggulu, triphala and the three pungents in equal parts with ghee remove a bad sinus wound, colic and fistula mouth.
Haritaki cooked in urine with oil and salt one should take each morning; it removes phlegm and wind diseases.
One should drink a decoction of the three pungents and triphala with alkali and salt; in cases of phlegm-wind nature a purge removes phlegm increase.
A drink boiled with pippali, pippali-root, vacha, chitraka and ginger destroys ama-vata (rheumatism).
Rasna, guduchi, castor, devadaru and ginger one should drink in all-over wind disease with ama in joints, bones and marrow;
or one should drink dashamula decoction with ginger water. A decoction of ginger and gokshura taken each morning
cooks ama-vata and lumbar pain and destroys pain. Oil of prasarani with root, leaf and branch;
a paste of guduchi, the fine powder, or the decoction — having used for a long time one is freed from wind-blood (gout).
Pippali in increasing doses is to be used, or pathya with jaggery; prepared with patola, triphala, sharp pungent and clarified butter,
the cooked drink quickly conquers wind-blood with burning. Guggulu in warm and cold; guduchi with triphala water;
bala, punarnava, eranda, the two brihatis, gokshura with hing and salts, drunk, quickly removes wind pain.
One karsha of pippali root and five salts; pippali, chitraka, ginger, triphala, trivrit, vacha;
two alkalis, shadvala, danti, svarnakshiri, vishanika — a pill of the size of a jujube drunk with sauviraka.
In unripened swelling, trivrit; in advanced abdominal disease and the like, milk removes swelling; daru, punarnava and ginger are good.
Sprinkling likewise with decoction of arka, punarnava and neem conquers swelling. Three times the ash water of palasha with the three pungents,
ghee prepared and drunk makes piles fall, no doubt. Salt prepared with vishvaksena and nirgundi,
with vidanga, anala, rock salt, rasna, agra-kshara and daru; oil fourfold prepared, with pungent substances or water,
destroys scrofula and goitre by anointing. Decoction of shati, kunaga, bala with milk-juice —
paste of payasya, pippali and vasa, cooked, is beneficial in consumption. Vacha, vida, abhaya, ginger, hing, kushtha, agnidipyaka,
in parts of two, three, six, four, one, seven and five in order — the powder drunk destroys abdominal tumor, belly disease, colic and cough.
Patha, nikumbha, the three pungents, triphala and agni — a powder-pill cooked with urine crushes tumors, spleen and the like.
Vasa, neem, patola, triphala remove wind and bile; vidanga powder licked with honey destroys worms.
Haritaki with vidanga, rock salt, alkali and urine; bark of shallaki, badari, jambu, piyala, mango and arjuna
drunk with milk and smeared with honey, each stops bleeding. Bilva, mango, dhataki, patha, ginger and mocharasa in equal parts,
drunk with jaggery buttermilk, check even stubborn diarrhea. Changeri, jujube, curds, water, ginger and alkali,
boiled with ghee, a drink removes pain in prolapse of the anus. Vidanga, ativisha, mustaka, daru, patha and kalingaka
joined with pepper destroys swelling and diarrhea. With sugar, rock salt, ginger, krishna and honey or jaggery,
one should eat two haritakis each; he would live a hundred years happily. Triphala joined with pippali, with honey and ghee likewise;
amalaka powder steeped in that tulasi juice, joined with honey, ghee and sugar, having licked it one may drink milk in love with women.
With equal parts of powder of masha, pippali, rice, barley and wheat, one should cook an auspicious pippalika;
having eaten it one should drink milk sweet with sugar; new, like a sparrow, he would surely enjoy a woman ten times.
Samanga, dhataki flower, lodhra and blue lotuses — this should be given with milk, destroying women's menorrhagia.
Seed, kuranta, licorice, white sandal, roots of lotus and water lily, licorice, sugar and sesame:
in threatened miscarriage this is the best for retaining the embryo. Devadaru, nabha, kushtha, nalada, vishvabheshaja —
a paste ground with kanji and joined with oil removes headache. Poured warm through cloth, rock salt removes earache.
Juices of garlic, ginger and shigru, or of banana, separately; one should drink bala, shatavari, rasna and amrita with maireya.
Ghee with triphala is the best destroyer of cataract; a man should drink ghee prepared with triphala, the three pungents and rock salt;
good for the eyes, purgative, pleasant, digestive, destroyer of phlegm diseases. Filaments of blue lotus joined with cow-dung juice
